name: Hi-Klass Trading & Investment Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Hi-Klass Trading and Investment Ltd is in the business of trading 
 and investment in shares, stocks, securities, 
 and properties and also extends short-term 
 loans[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
a) HKTAIL is a Non-Systematically  Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company.
b) It is in the business of trading and investments in shares, stocks, securities, and properties. 
c) It extends short-term loans to corporate and Firms /high net-worth individuals. 
d) Company deals in all kinds of goods, commodities, merchandise produce, things, and shares on a ready or forward basis. 
e) It is also involved in the business of Investment Company and to invest in and to hold, purchase, sell, and deal with stocks, shares, bonds, debenture-stock, mortgage, and obligations.
f) It performs most of the financial service activities, except insurance and pension 
 funding activities, etc.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.39% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -13.5% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 26.7% of their holding.
